decisions.decision: Pnpm 11 Docker migration — rm -rf node_modules + pnpm install pattern (NOT --force, NOT --legacy, NOT force-legacy-deploy)
decisions.rationale: Empirically verified on host: pnpm install --force does NOT refresh injectWorkspacePackages snapshot ('Already up to date'). Selective rm of .pnpm cache also insufficient. Only working refresh path: full rm of all node_modules + reinstall. Content-addressable pnpm store at /pnpm/store survives via BuildKit cache mount so re-resolve is fast. No bandaids: zero --legacy flag, zero force-legacy-deploy escape hatch.
